empty.title: No chats yet
empty.body: Add an account to see your conversations here.
empty.waiting: Your chats appear here as soon as the first sync arrives from your phone.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting to {{account}}…
reconnecting.body: Your phone or this computer may be offline. Nothing is lost; it reconnects on its own.

loggedOut.title: {{account}} was logged out
loggedOut.body: Link it again to keep using it. Your local chats are kept.

welcome.title: Your conversations, at home.
welcome.body: Connect WhatsApp to start. More networks are on the way, and you can add as many accounts as you like.

language.title: Language
language.description: Defaults to your system language. Saved only on this computer.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.logOutBody: Privé unlinks this computer from {{network}} and deletes this account's data from this computer. Your chats stay on your phone.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Everything is stored locally in an SQLite database on this computer.
privacy.noServers: No Privé account, no Privé servers, no telemetry.
privacy.networkOnly: Network traffic goes only to the messaging networks you connect.

about.title: About
about.tagline: One private, local-first app for all your messaging accounts.
about.license: Free software under the MIT license.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.loadFailed: Your settings could not be loaded.
settings.saveFailed: Your settings could not be saved.

account.notLoggedIn: This account needs to be linked again.
account.connectFailed: Could not connect this account. Privé will keep trying.
account.invalidName: Use a name of up to 40 characters.
account.invalidColor: Choose one of the account colors.

engine.notFound: This network is not available in this version of Privé.
engine.loginMethodUnsupported: This network does not support that way of signing in.
engine.capabilityUnsupported: This network does not support that action.
engine.notImplemented: This feature is not available yet for this network.

message.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.

encryption.locked: Privé can't unlock your data: its key is no longer in this computer's keychain. To start fresh, quit Privé and delete its data folder; you can link your accounts again.
encryption.keychainUnavailable: Privé couldn't reach your system keychain, where it keeps the key that protects your data. Make sure the keychain is unlocked and open Privé again.
encryption.corrupt: Privé's key file is damaged, so your data can't be unlocked.

whatsapp.qrTimeout: The code expired before it was scanned. Try again with a new code.
whatsapp.pairingFailed: Linking didn't finish. Try again with a new code.
whatsapp.clientOutdated: WhatsApp no longer accepts this version of Privé. Update Privé to keep using this account.
whatsapp.multideviceRequired: Update WhatsApp on your phone to link devices, then try again.
whatsapp.loggedOutRemotely: This device was removed from Linked devices on your phone. Your local chats are kept.
whatsapp.streamReplaced: This account was opened somewhere else with the same session. Close the other copy of Privé.
whatsapp.temporaryBan: WhatsApp has temporarily blocked this account. Try again later.
whatsapp.unlinkOnPhone: Removed from this computer. To finish, remove Privé from Linked devices on your phone.

link.title: Link {{network}}
link.body: Scan the code with the phone that has the account you want to add.
link.qrAlt: QR code to link the account. Scan it with your phone.

status.waiting: Waiting for scan · the code refreshes automatically

addAccount.title: Add account
addAccount.subtitle: Choose a network. You can add as many accounts as you like.
addAccount.buildEngine: Every network is an engine. Want one that is not here?

welcome.title: Welcome to Privé
welcome.body: All your conversations in one private place. No account to create, no servers in the middle.

privacy.title: Before you start
privacy.body: Three things worth knowing. It takes 20 seconds.
privacy.agree: I understand and agree to the Disclaimer and the Acceptable Use Policy.

local.title: Everything stays on this computer
local.body: Your messages and sessions are stored only here, encrypted. No Privé account, no telemetry, ever.

unofficial.title: Unofficial connections
unofficial.body: Privé connects like a linked device. Networks may limit third-party apps, so you are responsible for your accounts.

personal.title: For your own conversations
personal.body: No spam, bulk messaging, scraping or monitoring other people. Privé is a personal tool.

connect.title: Connect your first account
connect.body: Add as many as you like later, even several of the same network.

ready.title: You are all set
ready.body: Your account is linked and stays connected. Your chats will appear in Privé in an upcoming version.
ready.skippedBody: Connect an account whenever you like with the + button in the sidebar.

loginSteps.step3: Tap Link a device and point your phone at this screen

conversation.comingSoon: Messages of this chat appear here in the next version.
